title: MIP-04 encrypted media: Blossom uploads, media tab, and group context refactor
body:
![marmot](https://blossom.primal.net/42d0a62f0cc8fd3c44802aae2d99031547486c4ae371c0a9db97131f3bf640b4.png)

This marmot-powered PR adds end-to-end encrypted media sharing to group chats via MIP-04: files are encrypted using the group's MLS epoch secret, uploaded to Blossom servers (with ephemeral or account-key signing), and published as kind-1063 rumors into the group event store. It also introduces a dedicated Media tab for browsing and decrypting shared files, a Blossom settings page, an account-scoped IndexedDB for persisting media metadata, and a full refactor of group sub-pages into context-driven mini-apps following the established GroupContext pattern.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Encrypted media uploads with inline playback and a per-group media gallery
  * Improved chat: composer with attachments, replies, reactions, and web app (webxdc) sessions
  * Group Admin page for editing name/description/relays
  * Blossom settings to configure upload servers and signing mode

* **Documentation**
  * Project renamed to "marmot-ts Web Chat" and added "Group Mini‑App Pattern" docs

* **Refactor**
  * Migration to marmot-ts and per-group media caching/backend improvements
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
